title: Facilities Manager
description: Official JLL Riyadh requisition for a facilities management role supporting day-to-day and strategic operations. Readable mirror text for the same posting describes planned preventative maintenance, reactive repairs, small projects from scoping through handover, client liaison, Corrigo work-order management, monitoring building operational performance and utilities, health and safety records, and deputy coverage for senior FM and technical supervision when needed. This is a practical facilities and property-operations lead with maintenance coordination, vendor and client management, and compliance exposure.
